title: jQuery Small Examples
description: Use these small jQuery examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Select a page part
examples.description: The jQuery function, often written $, selects page elements using a CSS selector.
examples.output: With jQuery loaded first, the console shows Reading club.

examples.title: Set plain text
examples.description: The text method reads or replaces text. A replacement is treated as words rather than HTML markup.
examples.output: The paragraph shows Bring a notebook.

examples.title: Add and remove classes
examples.description: A class name lets CSS handle the appearance.
examples.output: The note becomes gold through its bright class.

examples.title: Respond to a click
examples.description: The on method adds an event handler. It can run a function whenever the chosen element receives that event.
examples.output: The button fills the reply paragraph after a click.

examples.title: Read a typed value
examples.description: The val method reads the current value of a form control.
examples.output: Clicking the button logs whatever name is currently in the input.

examples.title: Read a checkbox state
examples.description: The prop method reads a live element property.
examples.output: The console shows true or false for the current check state.

examples.title: Find a nearby parent
examples.description: closest walks up from an element until it finds a matching ancestor or the element itself.
examples.output: The article receives the selected class. Add a CSS rule to make that state visible.

examples.title: Append a safe new item
examples.description: You can create an element and set its text before adding it to a list.
examples.output: The list gains one book item.

examples.title: Handle future child buttons
examples.description: A delegated handler is attached to a parent and checks matching child elements.
examples.output: Clicking the child button logs its data-title value through the parent handler.

examples.title: Remove only your handler
examples.description: Event namespaces let you label handlers for later cleanup.
examples.output: The final line removes this feature's click handler while leaving differently named handlers alone.

examples.title: Load a local JSON file
examples.description: getJSON makes a request for JSON data. done handles success, while fail handles a failed request.
examples.output: With a real local books.json file, its data is logged. A failed request shows a clear message.

examples.title: Compare with the standard DOM
examples.description: Many small jQuery jobs also have built-in browser equivalents.
examples.output: Both lines set the heading text. Only the first needs jQuery.
